text: So we came in at 7:20 on Sunday. This is a hotel buffet. We wanted to make sure we had enough time before the show upstairs at 10pm. We got into the digital waitlist - a total useless system. At 8:23pm they sent us back to pay. At 8:40pm we got told that probably not until 9:15pm we would get a table. So it was our party of two. No solution. Management should have warned us first. That we were not going to get a table until long after the pay time. That would have saved hours of wasted time. Total failure. If I gave one star to the food, I would give zero to the service. Not sure if zero stars is an option but that is what I would give.
